Specification: This module specifies a one-variable transition system over the natural numbers, with a single state variable x initialized to 0 and a next-state relation that allows x' to be any value in the range 0..3. The main specification is Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_x, with a commented-out fairness condition WF_x(Next), so the active temporal behavior allows arbitrary stuttering and arbitrary next values in 0..3. The rest of the file defines a collection of temporal properties involving [], <>, and ~>, together with TLAPS theorems or omitted proofs, apparently to test or reproduce behavior related to Github issue #604 and differences between TLC and TLAPS on simple liveness and leads-to formulas.
